    [mild] Proposition PPF, first part: the penny-farthing contour is v = α² #

    Case (PF) of [mild] Lemma 2.2: α is a loop at y with ρ = α and the arrow of v before α is α. Then x = y and v = α α (PFData.v_eq). The proof follows [mild]: an arrow β in front of αⁱ (i ≥ 2) gives the cleaving D̃₅ of figure 2.4 (first diagram) unless α α = η β or β α = g β, and both relations make v and w interlaced by Lemma 1.1; for v = αⁱ, i ≥ 3, the second D̃₅ of figure 2.4 is cleaving.
